name: Pyro Treasure Compass
desc:
A compass that can be used in Natlan to search for nearby chests.
Amidst the turmoil and strife that wrack the land, many treasures throughout the vast Nation of Pyro have gone unaccounted for, all trace of their whereabouts lost.

value.text: Forged by Blacksmith after using Diagram: Pyro Treasure Compass

customize.name: Diagram: Pyro Treasure Compass
customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step diagram for making a Pyro Treasure Compass. Use it to easily locate treasure all over Natlan.

customize.name: Golden Raven Insignia
customize.desc: A raven insignia that symbolizes the pride and the guiding principle of the Treasure Hoarders. Whether it's hidden amidst the vastness of the land or in the depths of the seas, as long as there are treasures to be hunted down, the spirit of Treasure Hoarders, who will stop at nothing to acquire them, will never die.

customize.name: Saurian Claw Succulent
customize.desc: A succulent shaped like the paw of a great animal.

customize.name: Crystal Chunk
customize.desc: An uncut crystal. Only professional craftsmanship can bring out its true value.

customize.name: Mora
customize.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

customize.text: A device that can detect nearby treasure. After using it, the location of nearby treasure chests will be indicated and marked out on the map.
Aside from directly finding treasure, the Treasure Compass can also find some places or clues that might lead to treasure...

customize.name: Anemo Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Mondstadt to search for nearby chests.
The needle of the Treasure Compass doesn't spin according to the world's magnetic field, but rather follows the energy of ley lines to lead the user to treasure.

customize.name: Geo Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Liyue to search for nearby chests.
The land of Geo is rich with valuable resources, with treasures hidden throughout the mountains and wilderness just waiting to be found.

customize.name: Electro Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A handy tool used to locate nearby chests in Inazuma.
The land of the thundering archipelago has suffered a great many past hurts. The many treasure chests that dot the islands is a symbol of its revival from these wounds.

customize.name: Dendro Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Sumeru to search for nearby chests.

For some people, the significance of life lies in exploration and discovery. Upon reaching each destination, there is always bountiful treasure awaiting.

customize.name: Hydro Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Fontaine to search for nearby chests.

These chests scattered across Fontaine are not the lawful property of any individual or organization. In most circumstances, it is legal to claim the contents found within.

customize.name: Luna Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Nod-Krai and the Frost Moon to search for nearby treasures and relevant clues.
This sublunary sphere holds countless unknown treasures, waiting to be discovered by adventurers with courage or wit.

customize.name: Segment-Domain Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
When used within the Temple of Space, this device detects nearby treasures and the related clues.
Even within the hidden vaults where the thousand winds cannot reach, there are still invisible threads that guide the way toward the most precious of collections — as well as the hidden meanings behind them.

customize.name: Cryo Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Snezhnaya to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.
Many treasures lie frozen in hidden places across the land of snow. Those who can undo the seals may claim the gifts left within the ice.
